sources.title: Qwen3.5 - Verdent Guides
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 is a family of open-weight, natively multimodal AI models designed for reasoning, coding, tool use, and image or video understanding. The family matters more than the bare name: Qwen3.5 includes multiple dense and mixture-of-experts checkpoints with very different memory, latency, and deployment requirements.
